stories.headline: A 10-year-old terrier survived 34 days lost in Yellowstone
stories.summary: Luna slipped out of a cabin and spent weeks dodging bears and wolves, even walking into lodges through automatic doors. Volunteers caught her in a trap baited with her family's clothes.
stories.why: Strangers, rangers and tourists all looked out for one little dog.

stories.headline: South Africa created a new national park for its grasslands
stories.summary: Grasslands National Park protects 10,225 ha across 18 farms near Rhodes. Farmers keep their land but sign on to protect it, guarding rare birds and a key water source.
stories.why: High mountain grasslands soak up rain and feed rivers far downstream.

stories.headline: A former child worker now teaches school dropouts
stories.summary: Sanjali Soren nearly left school to work at brick kilns until a social worker helped her finish. Now she runs a centre in Asansol, teaching dropouts in their own Santhali language.
stories.why: One person given a chance is now giving the same chance to others.

stories.stat_label: weeks in orbit, first images sent
stories.headline: Europe's new satellite sent its first stunning views of Earth
stories.summary: Just 2 weeks after launch, Sentinel-3C beamed back colour images of Italy and the Canadian Arctic. It will track sea ice, wildfires, drought and ocean heatwaves.
stories.why: Better eyes in orbit mean earlier warnings for heat, fire and floods.

fun_fact: Yellowstone covers about 3,500 square miles across Wyoming, Montana and Idaho.
